heading: Wednesday, July 30, 2025
topLine: Mistral releases Codestral 25.08 and enterprise coding stack.

items.headline: Mistral releases Codestral 25.08 and enterprise coding stack
items.summary: Codestral 25.08 is an update to Mistral's fill-in-the-middle code completion model, announced with an enterprise coding stack that includes Codestral Embed, Devstral and the Mistral Code IDE extension. Mistral reports 30% more accepted completions and 50% fewer runaway generations than the prior version.
